policy: Link, never mirror. The shelf (public/models/shelf.json) holds what the arcade OWNS (CC0, GLB, iPhone-sized); this index holds where to LOOK before modelling anything. Only models a game actually uses may be pulled in — converted to GLB and sized for iPhone — and every pull re-checks the license at the source. CI never downloads from these sources.

gate.ship: CC0 / public domain — may be added to the shelf directly (keep the LICENSE beside it)
gate.credit: attribution required (e.g. CC-BY) — ship only with a visible credit beside the model
gate.review: per-asset check before shipping (NC terms, trademarks, per-supplier packs)
gate.never: no redistribution (SCEA/ARR-style) — viewer/renderer testing only, never ships
gate.rule: a pack with several licenses takes its strictest component; see licenseGate() in src/utils/modelLibrary.js

iphoneBudget.note: guidance for pulled models, not a law the shelf enforces retroactively: aim <=512 KB per GLB, textures <=1024 px, Draco/meshopt where it matters. The current shelf's largest model is 342 KB.

libraries.name: Kenney Assets
libraries.what: Low-poly, flat-shaded packs: characters, cars, racing, industrial, RPG/village props, UI sprites. The retro/stylised fit — the shelf's KayKit voxel idiom sits in the same family.
libraries.licenseScope: uniform (almost all packs are CC0; check the per-pack page — a few are restricted)
libraries.pull: per-pack ZIP from kenney.nl contains .glb files ready to use; itch.io/npm mirrors exist too — download is a manual step outside CI (GitHub/npm-only network rule)

libraries.name: Quaternius
libraries.what: CC0 low-poly: characters, animals, cars, nature, modular buildings, weapons, universal animations. Retro/stylised fit.
libraries.pull: per-pack ZIP from quaternius.com (or their itch.io page) contains .glb; manual step outside CI

libraries.name: Poly Haven
libraries.what: CC0 photoreal assets: models, PBR textures and sky HDRIs. The MODERN-bar fit (Comet Drift HD-style titles, sky domes).
libraries.pull: per-asset download from polyhaven.com (choose glTF/GLB export; HDRIs come .hdr) — files are large, decimate + recompress for iPhone; manual step outside CI

libraries.name: Khronos glTF Sample Assets
libraries.what: The reference glTF corpus: tiny core-features models through showcase pieces, with glTF-Binary / Draco / quantized variants. For testing renderers and loaders.
libraries.licenseScope: per-asset: read Models/<name>/metadata.json legal[] before shipping anything from here
libraries.pull: raw.githubusercontent.com IS CI-allowed (GitHub); still check the asset's metadata.json legal[] — licenses differ per model (CC0 to SCEA)
libraries.status: link-list; shortlist below is license-verified against metadata.json

libraries.name: NVIDIA SimReady Central
libraries.what: ~2,000 OpenUSD assets: robot arms, warehouse gear, household appliances — with real mass, friction, collider and semantic data. The physics source for robot-learning games (pick-and-place, stacking, household tasks alongside the generic player slots).
libraries.licenseScope: per-asset: the license is set by each supplier — check every asset page before it ships
libraries.physicsData: mass, friction, colliders and semantics live in the USD layer; GLB carries no physics, so keep the USD-side record beside the converted model (in this index) so the option stays open
libraries.pull: USD→GLB conversion step required (usd-core / pxr); physics data must be transcribed to the shelf entry, not silently dropped; manual step outside CI

models.name: Box (vertex colours)
models.use: renderer/loader smoke test — the cheapest possible real GLB

models.name: Fox
